confidence_notes: A recent Bali-wide aggregate provides restaurant, cappuccino and draft-beer benchmarks, while current Kuta nightlife guidance gives a broad cocktail range. comparable_city_reasoning: Bali (Kuta) is a high-tourism destination. I used the recent Bali-wide aggregate as a local baseline for food, coffee and beer and Kuta/Legian bar guidance for drinks; lodging is a holistic estimate for a backpacker-oriented beach district.
